bio.en: Suzanne Collins (born August 10, 1962) is an American author and television writer. She is best known as the author of the young adult book series The Hunger Games. She also authorises the children's fantasy series The Underland Chronicles. bio.es: Sam Rockwell (5 de noviembre de 1968) es un actor estadounidense, ganador de un Óscar, un Globo de Oro, un BAFTA y un Premio del Sindicato de Actores al mejor actor de reparto por su papel en la película Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri. Es conocido por ser el protagonista de películas como Lawn Dogs, Confessions of a Dangerous Mind, Choke y Moon, y ha tenido papeles destacados en cintas como The Green Mile, Galaxy Quest, Clownhouse, Frost/Nixon, The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, Matchstick Men, Todos están bien, El asesinato de Jesse James por el cobarde Robert Ford y Iron Man 2.

bio.ca: Alberto San Juan Guijarro (Madrid, 1 de novembre de 1968) és un actor de cinema, teatre i televisió espanyol. El 2007 va guanyar el Goya al millor actor.

bio.es: Eduard Fernández es un actor español nacido el 25 de agosto de 1964 en Barcelona, Cataluña. Inició su trayectoria en el teatro y formó parte durante varios años de la compañía Els Joglars antes de consolidarse en el cine y la televisión. Entre sus trabajos más destacados se encuentran Fausto 5.0, En la ciudad, Biutiful, La piel que habito, Un día perfecto, El hombre de las mil caras, Mientras dure la guerra y la serie 30 monedas. A lo largo de su carrera ha recibido varios Premios Goya por interpretaciones protagonistas y de reparto.

bio.en: Richard E. Grant (born Richard Grant Esterhuysen; 5 May 1957) is a Swaziland-born English actor and presenter. He made his film debut as Withnail in the comedy Withnail and I (1987). Grant received critical acclaim for his role as Jack Hock in Marielle Heller's drama film Can You Ever Forgive Me? (2018), winning various awards including the Independent Spirit Award for Best Supporting Male. He also received Academy Award, BAFTA, Golden Globe, and Screen Actors Guild Award nominations for Best Supporting Actor.

bio.en: Bodhi Rae Breathnach (born August 16, 2011) is an Irish film, television, and stage actor. She is known for her work in literary adaptations, historical drama, and genre films, and has appeared in productions for film, television, and major British theatre institutions. Breathnach made her feature film debut portraying Susanna Shakespeare in Hamnet (2025), directed by Chloé Zhao, an adaptation of Maggie O’Farrell’s novel of the same name. The film marked her first major international screen role. She later starred as Jessie opposite Jason Statham in the action-drama Shelter (2026).

Markus Schleinzer (born 8 November 1971; Vienna) is an Austrian film director, screenwriter, casting director, and actor. He is best known his feature films Michael (2011) and Rose (2026). Before establishing as a filmmaker, Schleinzer built a long career as a casting director, working on more than 60 Austrian film and television productions and collaborating with directors including Michael Haneke, Ulrich Seidl, and Jessica Hausner. His background in casting has been widely cited by Schleinzer as a formative influence on his approach to acting and staging as a director.

John Christopher Reilly (born May 24, 1965) is an American actor. A character actor, he is known for leading and supporting roles in both independent films and major studio features. The recipient of various accolades, Reilly is one of only two people to have been nominated for an Emmy Award, a Grammy Award, an Academy Award, and a Tony Award (EGOT) without winning any. Reilly started his career in the late 1980s, gaining recognition for his supporting roles in Casualties of War (1989), Days of Thunder (1990), Hard Eight(1996), Boogie Nights (1997), Magnolia (1999), Gangs of New York (2002) and The Aviator (2004).

Sabina Berman Goldberg (born August 21, 1955) is a Mexican writer and journalist. Her work deals mainly with issues related to diversity and its obstacles. She is a four-time winner of the National Playwriting Award in Mexico (Premio Nacional de Dramaturgia Juan Ruiz Alarcón). She has twice won the National Journalism Award (Premio Nacional de Periodismo). Her plays have been staged in Canada, North America, Latin America, and Europe. Her novel, Me (La mujer que buceó en el corazón del mundo), has been translated into 11 languages and published in over 33 countries, including Spain, France, the United States, England, and Israel.

bio.es: Tom es el único hijo (entre cuatro hijos) de padres nómadas, Mary Lee (Pfeiffer), maestra de educación especial, y Thomas Cruise Mapother III, ingeniero eléctrico. Sus padres eran de Louisville, Kentucky, y él tiene ascendencia alemana, irlandesa e inglesa. Young Tom pasó su infancia siempre en movimiento, y cuando tenía 14 años había asistido a 15 escuelas diferentes en los Estados Unidos y Canadá. Finalmente se estableció en Glen Ridge, Nueva Jersey, con su madre y su nuevo esposo.

Thomas Stanley Holland (Kingston upon Thames, Londres; 1 de junio de 1996) es un actor y bailarín británico. Comenzó su carrera en el teatro en 2008 interpretando el papel principal en el musical Billy Elliot en el West End londinense. Debutó en el cine con el drama Lo imposible (2012), actuación por la que recibió el reconocimiento de la crítica. Posteriormente, participó en producciones como En el corazón del mar (2015) y Z, la ciudad perdida (2016).

bio.en: Yuval Abraham (Hebrew: יובל אברהם) is an Israeli investigative journalist, film director, and Arabic–Hebrew translator. He rose to international prominence when he co-directed No Other Land (2024), an Oscar-winning documentary about the Israel Defense Forces and settler violence in the West Bank, and gave a pro-equality speech at the 74th Berlin International Film Festival. In 2024, he was awarded the Emil Grunzweig Human Rights Award for his outstanding contribution to the advancement of human rights in Israel.
Michał Jan Kwieciński is a Polish producer, director, and screenwriter. Founder of the production company Akson Studio.

bio.en: Denden (でんでん Denden, born Yoshihiro Ogata (緒方 義博); 23 January 1950) is a Japanese actor and former comedian. He has appeared in more than one hundred films since 1981.

bio.en: Kyōko Kagawa (香川 京子 Kagawa Kyōko, born 5 December 1931) is a Japanese actress. She has appeared in leading and supporting roles in such films as Akira Kurosawa's The Bad Sleep Well and High and Low, Yasujiro Ozu's Tokyo Story, and Kenji Mizoguchi's Sansho the Bailiff. She won the "New Face Nomination" sponsored by the Tokyo Shimbun newspaper out of about 6,000 applicants and joined Shintoho. She was also taking entrance exams for a regular company at the same time, and her final interview and the final exam for the New Faces camera test overlapped, but with her mother's advice, she decided to pursue acting.

Brothers Jean-Pierre Dardenne (born 21 April 1951) and Luc Dardenne (born 10 March 1954), collectively referred to as the Dardenne brothers, are a Belgian filmmaking duo. They write, produce, and direct their films together. The Dardennes began making narrative and documentary films in the late 1970s. They came to international attention in the mid-1990s with La Promesse (The Promise). They won their first major international film prize when Rosetta won the Palme d'Or at the 1999 Cannes Film Festival. Their work tends to reflect left-wing themes and points-of-view. In 2002, Olivier Gourmet won Best Actor at Cannes for the Dardennes' Le Fils (The Son).

Mia Cailin Rodgers (born May 17, 2000) is an English actress. She studied at the Royal Central School of Speech and Drama and landed her breakout role as Taylor in the third season of The Sex Lives of College Girls.

bio.en: Jonno Davies (born July 17, 1992) is an English actor. He is best known in the UK and US for his role as Alex DeLarge in the stage production of A Clockwork Orange. In 2020, he appeared in the Amazon Prime series Hunters as Tobias.
